(()=>{const svg=document.querySelector("svg[aria-label="Editable architectural plan"]");window.demoRead=()=>{const id=document.querySelector(".architect-workspace").dataset.designId;return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("xray:architect:v1:"+encodeURIComponent(id)))};const p=demoRead();window.demoLevel=p.levels.at(-1).id;if(p.walls.some(w=>w.levelId===demoLevel))throw Error("New level not empty");window.demoPoint=(x,y)=>{const svg=document.querySelector("svg[aria-label="Editable architectural plan"]");const pt=new DOMPoint(x,y).matrixTransform(svg.getScreenCTM());svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent("pointermove",{bubbles:true,clientX:pt.x,clientY:pt.y,pointerId:1}));svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent("pointerdown",{bubbles:true,button:0,buttons:1,clientX:pt.x,clientY:pt.y,pointerId:1}));svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent("pointerup",{bubbles:true,button:0,clientX:pt.x,clientY:pt.y,pointerId:1}));};return {level:demoLevel,viewBox:svg.getAttribute("viewBox"),rect:svg.getBoundingClientRect().toJSON()}})()
